categories.main_business_segments: The company operates four primary business segments: battery chemical products (including lithium-ion battery electrolytes, additives, and new-type lithium salts), organic fluorine chemical products (including fluorine-containing fine chemicals and fluorine polymers), capacitor chemical products (including aluminum electrolytic capacitor electrolytes and related materials), and semiconductor chemical products (including high-purity chemicals and functional materials). These segments serve the energy storage, electronics, and semiconductor industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core production technologies including the ECOSIP™ Technology for green integrated processing of ethylene oxide to carbonate solvents, advanced purification and synthesis techniques for electrolyte materials, and specialized manufacturing processes for fluorine-containing compounds. The company operates multiple production facilities utilizing year-round manufacturing with strict quality control systems, and has developed proprietary formulations and synthesis methods for battery electrolytes, fluorine chemicals, and capacitor materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major battery manufacturers (including leading EV battery producers), capacitor manufacturers, semiconductor and display panel manufacturers, and pharmaceutical/agricultural chemical companies. Primary end markets include electric vehicles and energy storage systems, consumer electronics, industrial equipment, new energy infrastructure, and specialty chemical applications in pharmaceuticals and agriculture.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China (including facilities in Shenzhen, Huizhou, Nantong, Jiangmen, Chongqing, Yichang, Changsha, and Tianjin), Europe (Poland facility), and Asia-Pacific regions (Singapore, Hong Kong offices). The company also maintains representative offices in South Korea and Japan, with ongoing expansion plans in the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in raw material production (including solvent synthesis and lithium salt production), midstream in specialized chemical manufacturing and formulation, and downstream in direct supply to battery, capacitor, and semiconductor manufacturers. The company has integrated vertically to secure supply of critical raw materials including solvents, additives, and fluorine-based compounds.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in next-generation battery technologies including sodium-ion batteries, solid-state batteries, and high-voltage electrolyte systems. Strategic focus areas include developing environmentally-friendly fluorine products, expanding semiconductor chemical product lines, enhancing product performance for emerging applications (fast charging, wide temperature range), and establishing global production capacity to serve international customers. The company invests approximately 6-7% of revenue in R&D annually.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of specialized chemical products to battery manufacturers, capacitor producers, and semiconductor companies. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates a direct sales model with technical service support, providing customized solutions and long-term supply agreements with major customers. Secondary revenue includes licensing and technical service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In battery electrolytes, the company competes with Tianqi Materials and Ruite New Materials as primary competitors. The company ranks among the top suppliers globally for lithium-ion battery electrolytes and maintains leading market positions in capacitor chemicals and fluorine-based specialty chemicals. The company differentiates through integrated supply chain, advanced R&D capabilities, quality consistency, and established relationships with tier-one battery and electronics manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated revenue of RMB 7.48 billion in 2023 (down 22.5% from RMB 9.66 billion in 2022) with net profit of RMB 1.01 billion (down 42.5% from RMB 1.76 billion in 2022). Total assets reached RMB 17.62 billion at year-end 2023. The company experienced revenue decline in 2023 due to industry overcapacity and price competition, though maintains strong cash generation with operating cash flow of RMB 3.45 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through superior product quality and consistency, comprehensive integrated supply chain reducing costs and ensuring supply security, advanced R&D capabilities enabling customized solutions for emerging battery technologies, global production footprint enabling just-in-time supply, and long-term strategic partnerships with leading battery and electronics manufacturers. The company emphasizes environmental sustainability, safety, and technical innovation as core value drivers.
